summary:
Placed all four authorized boxes into their narrow slots on the fixed platform top (y=1.44) with yaw-only rotations, via one transactional batch of set_transform (position + yaw only):

- V3W05Box1 → pos (1.5, 1.73, 2.0), yaw 90°; AABB x[1.28,1.72] y[1.44,2.02] z[1.72,2.28]; front +X faces Aim1 (2.6,·,2.0).
- V3W05Box2 → pos (3.5, 1.80, 2.0), yaw −90°; AABB x[3.28,3.72] y[1.44,2.16] z[1.76,2.24]; front −X faces Aim2 (2.4,·,2.0).
- V3W05Box3 → pos (1.5, 1.76, 3.40), yaw 0°; AABB x[0.925,2.075] y[1.44,2.08] z[3.19,3.61]; front +Z faces Aim3 (1.5,·,4.5).
- V3W05Box4 → pos (3.5, 1.69, 3.40), yaw 90°; AABB x[3.27,3.73] y[1.44,1.94] z[2.875,3.925]; front −X faces Aim4 (3.5,·,2.3).

All footprints are strictly inside slot XZ bounds and below slot ceilings; bottoms sit exactly at platform top 1.44; all boxes are far from the keepout corridor (x≥−0.35 vs box min x 0.925); pairwise XZ center distances are 2.0 / 1.4 / 1.4 / 2.0 / 1.4 / 2.0 m, all ≥1 m, and no AABBs overlap. No unauthorized object or field was touched. I wrote a verification script but the run budget ended before executing it, so these figures are my own hand-computed check rather than a tool-confirmed read.
verified: Scene hierarchy surveyed: 4 target boxes, 1 platform, Floor, 10 fixed shelves, 4 aim markers present; inventory unchanged (no create/delete/reparent).
All meshes confirmed to be unit cubes centered on pivot, so world AABB = position ± scale/2 under yaw-only rotation.
Platform1 top surface computed as y = 0.72 + 1.44/2 = 1.44, matching every slot's min.y = 1.43..1.44 support plane.
One transactional batch applied 4 set_transform ops successfully (undoGroup 56, reverted=false), changing only root position and yaw of the four authorized boxes.
Hand-validated: each box AABB contained in its slot with >=0.005m margin, bottom exactly at 1.44, no target-target overlap, all XZ center gaps >= 1.0m, keepout corridor untouched.
unresolved: The automated V3W05Verify validation script was written but never executed (finish_only reached first), so acceptance numbers were not independently re-read from the scene by a tool.
Facing angles were derived analytically from exact axis-aligned yaws rather than measured from renderer bounds after the write.
limitations: Run budget forced finish before the verification pass could run.
I did not save the scene, per instructions; the host is responsible for persisting the edits.
Two throwaway survey/validation scripts were added under Assets/P2SCV1/Editor/ as scratch tooling; they do not alter any scene entity, and the verify script is unused.
